name: Quantum Mechanics II
description: Time-independent perturbation, time-dependent perturbation, Rayleigh–Schrödinger theory, variational methods, identical particles, WKB approximation, Born approximation, Hartree–Fock method, adiabatic and sudden approximations, semiclassical radiation–matter interaction, selection rules, Klein–Gordon equation, Dirac equation, spin, antiparticles.
